## 2026-11-19 JST: 公式A/B照合の接続と実レース検証

全国A/B処理の不足箇所を修正し、公式日程・結果、締切前のGitHub保存証拠、既存RSA/AES原本、同一母数の採点、暗号化した結果履歴、所有者用HTML／オフライン閲覧を接続しました。

- 公開済みソース: [f06b15ae](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/commit/f06b15aee0c6d615deed9dceda8cbdfe41042c98)。
- [そのコミットの全国A/B CI](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/44414437961)で315 tests / OKを確認。関連4 workflowもsuccess。これは本番の全国取得・採点成功ではありません。
- 独立レビューで、取得対象の固定、改訂日程による母数欠落、過去日・証拠の巡回偏り、同内容pollによる暗号履歴増加、日付をまたぐ取得拒否後の追加GETを修正確認。
- 実データの受入れは宇都宮 `202611182401` の1組。真の保存原本、GitHub server metadataとZIP digest、公式取得済みbytes、既存鍵の認証・モデル再演算を照合。A12点・B8点はいずれも不的中。全国79Rを母数に保ち、今回未読込の78Rを不的中としていません。
- [実証receipt](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/blob/f06b15aee0c6d615deed9dceda8cbdfe41042c98/docs/evidence/2026-11-19/keirin_utsunomiya1r_official_AB_settlement_safe_v1.json)と[完成条件の監査](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/blob/f06b15aee0c6d615deed9dceda8cbdfe41042c98/docs/KEIRIN_OFFICIAL_AUTOMATION_COMPLETION_AUDIT_20261119.md)。

公式の継続取得条件、提供元の拒否・入力不足、未確認の返還形式、mainでの既存Secret実行、既存定期処理との同時稼働、未来日の全国一巡、映像の独立ラベル、実端末表示は引き続き別の受入れ条件です。全国無人運転の完成や、この積み重なった研究Draft全体のmergeを主張しません。

本番向けに必要な依存だけを切り出した独立Draftは [PR #309](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/pull/309) です。基点mainから75ファイルを追加し、既存ファイルは変更していません。既存PR71・daily discoveryとの取得重複、モデル系統、拒否停止、保存競合の運用条件も導入文書に明記しています。

---

## 2026-11-18 現行の最優先開発ゴール：全国全レース A/B（C任意）

本人指示により未完成の共通4モデルは比較の親ソース・必須条件から除外。A=既に生成している/今後実生成する予想、B=6局面・戦術分岐、C=独立認証済み追走履歴を加えたB（**なくてもA/B実施**）。

全国の**2026-11-18は8会場79レース**。通常ページ50Rから漏れる**静岡11R・宇都宮9R・高知9R**も含め、G1/F1/F2・ガールズ・6車・ナイター・ミッドナイト全件を事前登録。初期登録Gitコミット 4f601b9、締切前AES保全済みは西武園1RのA/B 1件、**他78Rの実予想と正式結果比較は未合格**。同日の初レースより前に全国79Rの母数を固定し、NO_FORECASTを的中/不的中として扱わない。将来日についても会場数・レース数を固定ハードコードしない。

[現行の全国A/B正本](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/blob/research/keirin-six-phase-score-20261114/docs/KEIRIN_NATIONWIDE_AB_ALL_RACES_20261118.md) / [79R登録台帳](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/blob/research/keirin-six-phase-score-20261114/docs/evidence/2026-11-18/keirin_all79_nationwide_AB_registered_v1.json) 。以下は過去の旧PR71研究文書を含む経緯であり現行の必須条件ではない。PRはDraft、本番main・Secret変更や有料外部サービスは未実施。

---

## 2026-11-18 現行比較方式（所有者最優先指示）

未完成の共通4モデルは新研究の予想A・比較対象・完成条件から**除外**。現在生成・保存されている予想A（例：11/17全国71R V3）を親とし、6局面予想Bを生成。独立確認済み追走履歴がある場合のみC（B＋連係経験）を追加する。Cが未完成でもA/Bを進める。新規比較コードと正式正本は [KEIRIN_ACTIVE_GENERATED_AB_OPTIONAL_C_20261118.md](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/blob/research/keirin-six-phase-score-20261114/docs/KEIRIN_ACTIVE_GENERATED_AB_OPTIONAL_C_20261118.md)。以下の旧「PR71四モデルを親にする」説明は経緯であり、現行の完成条件ではない。

---

## Purpose
**Reuse the existing KEIRIN PR71 forecast + PR #102 video/PDCA assets.** Add only the missing six-stage evidence/score overlay; do not replace the model, recorder, learner, or result scorer. This is stacked on existing Draft PR #290 and does not touch production `main`.

## Implemented
- SHA-linked, pre-cutoff **private** six-phase sidecar for an existing one-of-four PR71 model original; validates six stages, source/input hashes, timezone-aware clock, cutoff margin, and create-once + byte-SHA readback.
- Pure post-race comparison of independently reviewed PR #102 clip-admission frame receipts and per-phase rider/line/attack observations; no pixel-classification claims.
- User's requested weights: INITIAL=10, BELL=15, FINAL_HOME=15, FINAL_BACK=20, FOURTH_CORNER=15, GOAL=25.
- Initial subcomponents leader/top3/line groups/second-wheel/visible attack. `UNKNOWN` never counts as a failed or perfect stage. Report visual coverage, comparable coverage, weighted earned points and conditional accuracy separately.
- Fail-closed on wrong SHA, phase identity/order, replay-frame reuse, missing independent original/visual/rights/schedule/result attestation, late or tampered original. Never auto-learn, auto-merge, change betting or official ROI.
- Tests registered in **existing** KEIRIN PR71 synthetic CI; no new workflow/scheduler/provider/secret/storage. Test cases are fictional 2030 races, not 武雄2R production labels.

## Actual verified blockers
- Live owner run 43582550517: provider access denial, no qualifying new formal four-model snapshot.
- Real video capture 43567244002: 8 encrypted browser recordings and 362 scene-feature frames, but 0 independently verified tactical labels and private long-term archive unavailable (independent acceptance 43568226669 fails).
- 武雄2R ~2m48s / 1-7-2 is **user-reported research context**, not a validated GitHub pre-cutoff forecast original, private clip SHA, official result or AI-extracted stage data. **Excluded from formal training/ROI**.

## Completion gates remaining
Run CI; wire this schema to the existing producer's **encrypted** state + fresh-runner readback when a real full input is available; produce actual rider/line stage annotations by the existing PR102 video pipeline, independently verify rights, join official result; then site view and blind forward cohort evaluation. No synthetic CI result is live proof.

Technical handoff: `docs/KEIRIN_SIX_PHASE_OVERLAY_20261114.md`. **DRAFT / DO NOT MERGE** until audited.

## Verified offline code-path integration (2026-11-14)
- Existing pinned PR71 `FourModelRankLedger.read_suite` frozen four-model SQLite output -> exact per-model SHA -> six-stage before-cutoff sidecar: fictional-input integration passes.
- Existing immutable PR #102 `keirin_video_clip_policy.assess_clip` -> receipt-bound frame pairs -> six-stage scorer: fictional-video integration passes.
- New regressions **29** total (phase 23 + PR102 2 + PR71 4). GitHub Actions [run 43586082434](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43586082434) SUCCESS on `4d782779671703c46dc26e676cb9e7e649a31835`; later documentation-only commit still requires checking its own CI if triggered.
- No real phase labels for Takeo 2R, no source permissions or footage verification, no live formal forecast, no main merge. Completion and model training are **NOT** claimed.

## Latest final HEAD CI
- Head `e2f55080b7092bad017e464fe10e2bad7caf566d` (fixed six-phase and component weights; strict private-dir freeze guard). GitHub Actions [43586233193](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43586233193) **completed/success** against this HEAD.
- 29 new fictional offline regressions (23 scoring contract + 2 existing pinned PR102 clip admission + 4 existing pinned PR71 real-code private SQLite suite integration) and all existing tests in that workflow passed. The protected main still points at `b4206312594e...`; no live input, video, result or learning success claimed.
## 2026-11-15 JST continuation: reproducible HTTP 403, source HOLD, real-code rider gate
- Main [PR71 run 43615418955](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43615418955) returned provider-denied HOLD, no formal model forecast; independent live model readback skipped.
- GitHub metadata [capture run 43619018351](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43619018351), artifact 14123028109 (ZIP SHA256 9a62bda0fd0df47ee7822c5c84fa52e32d168b89e8112d6bc42c1a832cf09a) confirms 24/24 HTTP 403 mislabeled as race identity mismatch, zero sealed clips.
- Corrected existing PR #102 capture and wave stop: source release c52ff0216435b97a0209c43bbe5d0de589445736, offline [run 43621134941](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43621134941) 5/5 tests green. Exact source SHA pinned in this research PR's existing capture and PR71 CI workflow; main unaffected.
- Source collector now classifies sanitized provider refusal / budget / not published / network failure in original scripts/keirin_cloud_owner_inputs.py; no new GET after a provider denial, no partial pre-race model promotion.
- Added race_ai/keirin_frame_rider_identity_gate.py and tests. Requires source-bound PR102 frame SHA/review refs, two independent consistent LIVE frames, verified PR71 saved roster/model/input SHA, correct car/rank and approved visual attestor. Only leader and top3 candidate observations can reach the existing six-stage scorer; line/second-wheel/attack are UNKNOWN until separately independently observed. This is NOT a new AI or trained OCR and it has ZERO real rider recognition proof.
- New branch CI [run 43622485918](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43622485918) and HEAD [43622641874](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43622641874) both green for research code only; no production video success.
- Durable detailed evidence and remaining gates: docs/KEIRIN_SIX_PHASE_OVERLAY_20261114.md. Keep Draft, no main merge, no paid storage, no owner computer footage burden.

## 2026-11-15 JST additional line review gate
- Extended existing rider evidence gate with an **independently reviewed two-frame line-relation interface**. A partial view may score an independently confirmed immediate follower only; it must NOT grade the entire line as failed. Full line-group comparison requires **all 7/9 starters** independently position-confirmed in both frames.
- Existing PR71 roster and model SHA, PR102 clip frame SHA and review refs must agree; proposed line data alone is not authority. Attack and unseen movement remain UNKNOWN. No live video OCR or trained classifier introduced.
- Source-only PR102 five-test [run 43621134941](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43621134941) SUCCESS. Phase source-free [run 43623166641](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43623166641) SUCCESS: **18 new frame/roster/line tests**, plus previously implemented 23 phase tests, two PR102 adapter tests and four PR71 SQLite adapter tests. Parent #290 source-safe tests also pass.
- Current document+code HEAD **2256ee9b67b7da44de03149524704696f5b2ae88**: PR71 [43623240938](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43623240938), video flow [43623240977](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43623240977), video acceptance offline [43623240931](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43623240931) all CI SUCCESS. They are PR regressions, not main production recordings or independent model acceptance.
- **Remaining**: provider legitimately restores source access; actual encrypted/independently read-back future PR71 originals; authorized private media bytes; actual OCR/tracking with measured real accuracy; official result and stage comparisons; private durability, safe site and prospective learning A/B. No source bypass, new cost, changes to existing production weights, auto-purchase or main merge.

## 2026-11-15 JST: actual past-race media validation, not recognition accuracy
- Owner-private existing RSA/AES-GCM archives for **2026-11-09 Aomori 1R/2R/3R** were restored, authenticated-decrypted in a temporary local private workspace, and each raw recording SHA compared against the previously saved private frame-feature receipt.
- Existing frame sampling was reproduced with OpenCV at each recorded video second, using the prior screen-player crop. Exact BGR crop SHA256: **54/54**, **49/49**, **50/50**, total **153/153** samples equal, **0 mismatches**, **0 unreadable frames**. This is genuine private-media byte/frame integrity evidence, **NOT** an OCR/trajectory/rider-ID accuracy result.
- In those saved 153 observations, no independently verified individual rider IDs or tactical labels were found; they remain UNKNOWN. Do not infer a success rate or use them for formal training/ROI or official stage scoring.
- Redacted proof with dates, counts, SHA lineage and explicit remaining gates is at `docs/evidence/keirin_historical_three_races_frame_readback_20261115.json`. **No private key, decrypted video, cropped frame pixels or label guesses were committed**.
- Temporary working copies of the private RSA key and decoded media were cleared from the analysis container; source assets remain in the owner's private Library. Main branch unchanged, Draft/NO MERGE.

## 2026-11-15 JST: real 153-saved-frame historical color-evaluation continuation
- Authenticated existing owner-private AES-GCM Aomori 2026-11-09 1R/2R/3R WebM recordings against original SHA256. Re-decoded saved samples **54/54 + 49/49 + 50/50 = 153/153** pixel-crop SHA256 matching existing private features.
- For a strictly **single-review, manually localized** within-race held-out patch pilot: 1R t=48s 6 crops (4 decided/3 agree), 2R t=64s 5 crops (4/4), 3R t=78s 7 crops (5/5), total 18 cropped observed riders, 13 guesses, 12 matching the review (72.222% attempt coverage, 92.308% conditional one-review agreement). Color-only; **not automatic racer detection, digit OCR, true verified ID accuracy, or future-race generalization**. Five UNKNOWN and one discrepancy retained.
- The old provisional 2R 65-second frame was not one of the 153 saved two-second samples. Replaced with **64 seconds** before final numbers were recorded; do not reuse prior 11/10 out of 18 as the final sample.
- 3 races × 6 required phases = 18 phase slots; **zero independently validated phase positions/lines**, so position, line, and phase-scoring *accuracy* are NULL, never 0% or 100%. Training/model promotion forbidden.
- Code: race_ai/keirin_historical_rider_color_eval.py (color candidate with UNKNOWN), scripts/keirin_historical_color_eval_offline.py (owner-private genuine WebM+153 SHA audit runner), and 2 new test modules. New **9 + 5 synthetic tests**, same existing PR71 CI; no new model, media provider, scheduled job, paid storage or main change.
- Actual source redacted aggregate: docs/evidence/keirin_historical_color_single_review_153frames_20261115.json (source video SHA lineage, count-only results; no real screenshots, private review coordinates, private key or filenames with secrets). Supporting methodology and next acceptance gates: docs/KEIRIN_SIX_PHASE_OVERLAY_20261114.md.
- Owner-private review-crop manifest is kept outside public GitHub; its SHA256 is included in the redacted proof. Working decrypted video and private RSA key copies were deleted from the analysis runtime after evaluation.
- **Remaining**: real rider localization (detector) measured on a separate independently labeled future-race set, proper jersey-number OCR/identity, tracking and line/attack annotations, stage boundaries, real pre-cutoff original + official result join, and encrypted independent readback. CI success is only code-path evidence. Draft/DO NOT MERGE.

## 2026-11-15 JST: actual auto color-region pilot on three preserved Aomori recordings
- Private RSA/AES-GCM media from Nov 9 Aomori 1R (6 starters), 2R/3R (7) was reopened in an ephemeral private analysis runtime, with all 153/153 saved BGR crop SHA256 replays matching. No new source network calls or additional media rights assumed.
- Same existing Draft PR adds a lightweight automatic HSV connected-component candidate detector (race_ai/keirin_visual_jersey_proposals.py), SHA-bound private replay CLI (scripts/keirin_historical_auto_color_eval_private.py), private synthetic OpenCV regression tests, and an untrusted track policy. Manual coordinates are used ONLY after color detection for one-review comparison.
- On three previously single-reviewed target frame instants: 18 provisional individual torso/car labels versus 28 automatic color blobs; 12 one-to-one spatial matches <=40px and 12 matches of tentative jersey color, 12/18=66.667% exploratory joint agreement. The additional 16 blobs were NOT independently adjudicated false positives; one reviewed instant covered only 5/7 riders. This is NOT validated human detection or genuine digit OCR accuracy.
- 153 actual frames held 1,667 untrusted color blobs and 357 color tracks lasting >=2 saved frames; these are not 357 independently verified racers. Across the 12 matched reviewed-frame color blobs, 10 had a nearby same-colored candidate at -2/+2 seconds. This is NOT a measured person-tracking precision or verified rider continuity.
- Redacted evidence: docs/evidence/keirin_auto_jersey_color_153frames_20261115.json. Full constraints and next gates: docs/KEIRIN_SIX_PHASE_OVERLAY_20261114.md. No pixels, reviewed bounding coordinates or RSA private key were published.
- The 6-car video research gate now works in synthetic CI; immutable PR71 official four-model input still allows only 7/9 starters. Existing model, private originals, official results, ROI and learning are untouched.
- Missing and NOT claimed: independent second-rater labels, complete rider detection with white/black bibs, proven OCR, actual ordered position and line tracking, independently evidenced 6-stage scores (0/18), forward holdout uplift. Draft DO NOT MERGE; main unchanged.

## 2026-11-15 JST: unseen Takeo 1R and independent review acceptance gate
- Existing private encrypted archive for 2026-11-09 Takeo 1R (race ID 202611098401) successfully RSA/AES-GCM authenticated-decrypted with exact source video SHA 6dafdbe570b107d0059b946076b66a5ec60edc6a95bffee63b29106733262439. This is a *new race relative to the earlier Aomori 1R/2R/3R color pilot*, not proof of never-used-by-any-model historical data. Video 89.52s, 1280x720, 25fps.
- Frozen HSV color-blob configuration evaluated on 45 actual decoded frames sampled at 2s: 214 untrusted color regions in 43/45 frames; 2 SOURCE frames separately provisionally labeled from unannotated pixels BEFORE viewing candidate output, 14 tentative jersey colors; 10/14 one-to-one <=40px location matches, 9/14 same-color+location. **This is SINGLE visual review, not two independent reviewers, and NOT person detector precision/recall or OCR accuracy.** Additional blobs not adjudicated as false positives.
- 45 source-frame digests and 214 untrusted proposals were SHA-bound and frozen create-once in private temporary analysis (canonical SHA 0957fcea59c888f1ca2c2441009a548aeceb09956223b88a3462453786a02392). A first private single-review label record had SHA 06b6ea38f7ce55573beb4d425b090cad7c55cdfb766f0c96cf2de1756d930d35. Original private source remains unchanged. External trusted same-code and separate-runner readback are NOT yet verified.
- Added race_ai/keirin_blind_rider_holdout_gate.py: independent per-frame two-rater exhaustive annotation, identity/time/recording/proposal SHA checks, IoU spatial consensus, only then TP, FP, FN, precision/recall/F1 for the **same target object type**; disagreements/unreviewed truth are strict HOLD with metrics null. Color-region agreement remains separate from genuine digit OCR/person ID and six-phase accuracy.
- Added scripts/keirin_blind_video_review_packets.py: source-bound private 45-frame images for two separate blinded reviewer slots without prediction boxes. Two 45-image private packet sets were generated in temporary storage; **no reviewer identities assigned, no second review completed, and no private images/coordinates sent to public GitHub**. Same source can regenerate packets once private original and frozen SHA are restored.
- New offline regressions: 16 holdout-metric gate + 6 private reviewer packet contracts. Real GitHub Actions [43669854179](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43669854179) completed/success with existing PR71/PR102 synthetic regressions. Successful offline CI does not prove real independent labels.
- Durable redacted real-source evidence: docs/evidence/keirin_takeo1r_unseen_color_holdout_20261115.json; stepwise review acceptance: docs/KEIRIN_TAKEO1R_BLIND_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_GATE_20261115.md. All real accuracy metrics still null and all six formal phases 0/6; no PR71 original, formal accuracy, model weights, learned tactics, main or site changed.
- **NEXT:** independently assigned/exhaustive two reviewer annotations on identical source images, resolve any disagreement, fresh independent archive+model lineage readback, actual person/bib/tracking assessment on multiple unseen races. Only after that should existing scorer/PDCA be considered for production activation. Draft/DO NOT MERGE.

## Final handoff / latest verified research HEAD (2026-11-15 JST)
- HEAD `4b14ce0d0091d2eff302f9aed9dbe4bec4cc817d`: [PR71 synthetic CI run 43670240236](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43670240236) **completed/success** with 16 two-review holdout gate tests and 6 private review-packet tests; additional existing regression suites passed. The two other PR workflows also completed success, but no actual hosted private-video processing or independent reviewers ran in those CI jobs.
- New real research proof: `docs/evidence/keirin_takeo1r_unseen_color_holdout_20261115.json`; acceptance guide: `docs/KEIRIN_TAKEO1R_BLIND_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_GATE_20261115.md`.
- In private ephemeral analysis, 45 frames/214 candidate regions bound to Takeo 1R video SHA, 14 first-review provisional color labels at two samples, and 9 tentative joint color/spatial matches; full 45-frame prediction manifest read back and two 45-image blind-review placeholder slots generated. **No actual independent second review**, so independent FP/FN, person recall/precision, OCR/identity, track, phase PDCA remain NULL/UNKNOWN and no model promotion authorized.
- Source ciphertext, RSA private key, video and private annotations were only materialized as temporary copies from the owner's existing private Library. After preserving public-safe hashes and code, the **ephemeral working directory was deleted**; original private Library files remain unchanged. The review images must be regenerated from the same authenticated video and SHA if/when reviewers are available, not claimed durably stored.
- Existing PR102/PR71 prediction models, main, site and model parameters unchanged; Draft DO NOT MERGE until proper source/review evidence.

## 2026-11-15 JST: next gate progressed, true independent labels still 0
- Current source/main changed separately, but this Draft PR remains isolated. Do not merge without reviewing production conflicts and genuine acceptance.
- Existing ciphertext archive restored authenticated 2026-11-09 **Takeo 2R** `202611098402`, source WebM SHA `4e389a46c223b7cb2eaa7c5c5bdc34ade229deedea8a3c795c8be987b57aa810`. The exact PR291 public detector code SHA `2493ee8738bc171c80440d751ce83b842d77d52fe5a550796579b92b3adf95f8` was transported from PR71 CI artifact #14146597007, then run locally on **46 original source frames, 222 untrusted color-region candidates**. It did not take manual positions or race outcome as input. 
- Frozen source-bound candidate `proposal_sha256=b207ec30d3fb368b9d9e64b494aa8e9e3657aac388023226c798da8ba8a98bae`, immutable file SHA `d31f4786e91375eded54f57a955e8bae156d4cfd2d4ef679793dc4558f760869`; A/B independent preview packets each contain 46 unlabeled source-frame PNGs. Three owner RSA-OAEP/AES-256-GCM ZIPs were produced and tag/digest/decryption checked. Their exact public-safe SHA evidence is in `docs/evidence/keirin_takeo2r_46frame_frozen_blind_packets_20261115.json`. Video and private key were never published.
- A *different run* [43677376341](https://github.com/haji84/RACE-AI/actions/runs/43677376341) exported the exact public `scripts/keirin_restore_blind_owner_packets.py` code. It was used to **actually restore all three encrypted archives** in a private process, confirming matching frozen prediction bytes and A/B each 46 images+2 unsigned forms. The owner-private decrypted temporary directory and temporary RSA key copy have been cleared. Cross-host production readback remains **NOT verified**.
- Separate external historical racecards confirmed seven actual race entrants, car numbers 1..7, but **no actual on-pixel person→car or lineup reference label**. The detector had been frozen before the roster web lookup. No after-result leak or retroactive model training.
- New independent Ed25519 trust gate `race_ai/keirin_signed_blind_review_gate.py`, offline signing helper `scripts/keirin_sign_blind_review_private.py`, and encrypted packet restore helper `scripts/keirin_restore_blind_owner_packets.py`. Two different keys alone MUST NOT authorize a score. An independently owned third-party trust-registry attestor, separate key/challenge receipts, true complete frame labels, verified video and model lineage are required. In their absence the existing holdout scorer reports HOLD and precision/recall/ID accuracy=NULL. No signing keys, real signed reviews or actual human verified frame labels have been obtained.
- A/B sealed packet files are current-conversation downloadable encrypted attachments, **NOT newly persisted to private Library**: the Library upload attempt failed with destination_conflict. The public GitHub repo contains only code, safe hashes and the handoff, never raw pixels/box coordinates/private keys. The original encrypted WebM still resides in existing owner-private Library.
- Full restart and real remaining acceptance: `docs/KEIRIN_TAKEO2R_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW_RESTART_20261115.md`. Main, PR71 weights, official score, PDCA, wagers and site remain untouched. Keep Draft, **DO NOT MERGE** until actual external independent labels and genuine live production proof.

## 2026-11-15 JST: two real-frame OFFLINE blind annotation workbenches (still zero real independent labels)
- Existing Takeo 2R frozen source `202611098402` verified from owner-private RSA/AES archive; 46 frames × 2 unsigned reviewer slots. Created separate **standalone offline HTML annotation interfaces** from the exact tested PR source, with embedded 46 original PNG images per reviewer, zero detector bounding boxes/guessed cars, image-drag bbox markup, explicit vehicle/evidence/rank/line/UNKNOWN, per-frame exhaustive checklist, local JSON export/resume.
